course_description: Provides introduction to mobile application development for android platform. In this course, students learn both the practical and conceptual skills that enable them to develop robust android/IOS applications. Students learn skills for creating and deploying Android/IOS applications, with particular emphasis on software development, including software architecture, software design, usability, and deployment.

course_learning_outcomes.text: Design a mobile / web application using Flutter.
Develop a mobile web application to solve real life problems.
Evaluate the functionality and usability of the applications.
Demonstrate 21st century skills in all learning activities.

topic_learning_outcomes.text: Design the application using various widgets.
Design application using forms , dialog boxes and menu.
Develop a useful and helpful mobile / web application.
Present the mobile / web application project.
Collaboration, Skilled Communication, Knowledge Construction, Self-Regulation, Real-World Problem-solving, Use of ICT (not part of topic, but integrated in assessments)
